description: Check one listing the user found against local evidence: asking price vs the same home type's recorded £/m² (with floor area or a bedroom-based ballpark) or median price, the LSOA then its MSOA (all types only as indicative-only), typicalPrice, a flood line, turnover, growth, the local authority's official HPI, costs (stamp duty on the asking price, the council tax by band), crime with its offence mix, noise, schools (state and independent counts), planning rules (home: conservation, Article 4, listed buildings), listed buildings recorded at or near the postcode (listedNearby), the IMD decile, and the questions to ask the agent (lease, service charge, EWS1, listing). Not a valuation.

bad.description: What was wrong, missing or confusing.
bad.title: Bad

call_id.description: The callId of the answer you are rating.
call_id.title: Call Id

fix.description: The change to the tool or its answer you would want.
fix.title: Fix

good.description: What was useful in the answer.
good.title: Good

rating.description: 1 = useless or wrong, 3 = usable with gaps, 5 = exactly what was needed.
rating.title: Rating

asking_price.description: £ (buy) or the rent in its rent_period (rent).
asking_price.title: Asking Price

floor_area_sqft.description: Floor area in sq ft if the listing states it; converted server-side (1 sq ft = 0.092903 m²).
floor_area_sqft.title: Floor Area Sqft

floor_area_sqm.description: Floor area in m² if the listing states it.
floor_area_sqm.title: Floor Area Sqm

intent.description: Optional, one to three sentences you write: what the user is looking for with this call and the criteria that matter, e.g. '2-bed rental near King's Cross, up to £2,500 a month, quiet, good primary schools'. Close Knit reads these to improve its answers. Your own summary, not the user's words or the chat; never names, contact details, exact addresses or family circumstances.
intent.title: Intent

postcode.description: Full postcode of the listing, e.g. W5 2NU.
postcode.title: Postcode

property_type.description: Property type if the listing states it; used for a same-type comparison.
property_type.title: Property Type

rate_previous.description: Optional: your rating of an earlier Close Knit answer, by the callId it carried. Send it with your next Close Knit call every time you have used an answer: rating 1-5 for how well it served the user's request, what was good, what was bad or missing, and the fix you would want.

rent_period.description: The rent's period: month = £ per calendar month, week = £ per week (converted ×52/12 for the comparison).
rent_period.title: Rent Period

share_percent.description: Shared-ownership share for sale, e.g. 25: the asking price is compared as asking_price ÷ share against whole-home prices. Omit when the listing does not state it (the verdict stays unknown).
share_percent.title: Share Percent

tenure.description: Tenure if the listing states it; lease questions are hedged ('If leasehold') when unknown and skipped for freehold.
tenure.title: Tenure

name: assess_listing
title: Assess listing
